title: Button
summary: A pressable control that performs a single activation action.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Visible text or equivalent naming content for the action.

anatomy.name: icon
anatomy.description: Optional graphic that accompanies or replaces the label; icon-only buttons still need an accessible name.

keyboard: Enter activates the button
Space activates the button
accessibility: Expose a button role with a clear accessible name from content or an explicit literal. Keep a visible focus indicator. Disabled buttons must not be activatable. Do not rely on color alone to convey the pressed or loading condition.
motion: Press feedback may scale or darken briefly; under reduced motion, snap to the pressed appearance without bouncing.

mappings.web: Prefer native HTML button; ARIA role=button only when a native button cannot be used.
mappings.apple: SwiftUI Button or UIKit UIButton with an explicit accessibility label when needed.
mappings.android: Compose Button or Material Button; ensure contentDescription when icon-only.

title: Link
summary: A navigation affordance that moves to another location or view.
keyboard: Enter activates the link
accessibility: Expose a link role with a destination-oriented name. Distinguish links from buttons in semantics even when styled similarly. Disabled or inert links must not remain in the tab order as activatable controls.
motion: Underline or color transitions may ease in; under reduced motion, apply the hover and focus styles immediately.

mappings.web: Prefer native HTML a with href; role=link only as a last resort.
mappings.apple: SwiftUI Link or NavigationLink mapped to the platform navigation pattern.
mappings.android: Compose TextButton/Clickable Text or Material navigation affordances with proper semantics.

title: Text field
summary: A single-line or multi-line field for entering text.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Visible label associated with the field.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.description: Validation message when the value is invalid.

keyboard: Tab moves focus into and out of the field
Printable keys insert text when editable
accessibility: Provide an accessible name via the visible label relationship. Describe errors with a programmatic relationship to the input. Do not convey required or invalid status by color alone.
motion: Caret and subtle focus ring transitions are acceptable; under reduced motion, show focus without pulsing.

mappings.web: Native input or textarea with associated label; aria-invalid and aria-describedby when needed.
mappings.apple: SwiftUI TextField or TextEditor with labeled accessibility traits.
mappings.android: Compose TextField or OutlinedTextField with supporting and error text semantics.

title: Checkbox
summary: A dual-state or tri-state control for selecting an option independently of others.
keyboard: Space toggles the checkbox when focused
accessibility: Expose a checkbox role with checked, unchecked, or mixed state. The name comes from the associated label. Group related checkboxes with a visible group label when they form a set.
motion: Checkmark may draw in quickly; under reduced motion, set the checked glyph instantly.

mappings.web: Native input type=checkbox with label; aria-checked for custom mixed states.
mappings.apple: SwiftUI Toggle with checkbox style or UIKit UISwitch alternatives only when the contract matches.

title: Radio
summary: A single-select option within a mutually exclusive group.

anatomy.name: group-label
anatomy.description: Name of the mutually exclusive set.

keyboard: Arrow keys move selection within the group
Space selects the focused radio when appropriate for the platform pattern
accessibility: Expose radio semantics inside a radiogroup with a group name. Only one option in the group is selected. Arrow-key navigation must not jump out of the group unexpectedly.
motion: Selection indicator may fade or scale slightly; under reduced motion, switch selection without animation.

mappings.web: Native input type=radio within a fieldset/legend or radiogroup pattern.
mappings.apple: SwiftUI Picker with radio-group semantics or equivalent exclusive selection control.

title: Switch
summary: A binary toggle that immediately commits an on or off setting.

anatomy.name: track
anatomy.description: Background track indicating off and on.

keyboard: Space toggles the switch
Enter may toggle where the platform convention allows
accessibility: Expose a switch role with on/off state and a clear label. Do not use a switch for actions that only navigate; prefer a button or link for those cases.
motion: Thumb travel may ease across the track; under reduced motion, jump to the on or off position.

mappings.web: Native checkbox styled as a switch with switch role, or a button with aria-checked when appropriate.

title: Combobox
summary: An editable input combined with a listbox of suggested or constrained options.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.description: Editable text field for filtering or free text.

anatomy.name: trigger
anatomy.description: Optional button that expands the popup.

keyboard: Arrow keys move the active option in the listbox while preserving the editable input
Enter selects the active option
Escape collapses the popup without losing input focus unexpectedly
Printable keys edit the input value
accessibility: Preserve editable-text behavior while exposing combobox, listbox, and option relationships, including expanded state and the active descendant or focused option. The accessible name comes from the field label. Collapsing the popup must leave the user oriented in the input.
motion: Popup may fade or slide a short distance; under reduced motion, show or hide the list instantly.

mappings.web: ARIA combobox pattern with native input plus listbox; prefer proven design-system comboboxes.
mappings.apple: SwiftUI searchable picker or custom field + menu that keeps text editing intact.
mappings.android: Compose ExposedDropdownMenuBox or equivalent editable dropdown pattern.

title: Tabs
summary: A selection pattern that connects a tab list to corresponding tab panels.

anatomy.name: tabpanel
anatomy.description: Panel whose visibility follows the selected tab.

keyboard: Arrow keys move focus among tabs according to orientation
In automatic activation, focus also selects and shows the panel
In manual activation, focus moves without selecting until Space or Enter activates
Home and End may jump to first and last tab when supported
accessibility: Distinguish selection from activation: selection identifies the current tab and visible panel; activation is the gesture that commits selection when the pattern is manual. Expose tab, tablist, and tabpanel relationships with correct orientation. Do not confuse this pattern with a top-level application tab bar that only performs navigation.
motion: Panel crossfades or indicator slides may run on selection; under reduced motion, switch panels without sliding content.

mappings.web: ARIA tabs pattern or native design-system tabs with correct roles and keyboard mode.
mappings.apple: SwiftUI TabView only when it matches in-page selection; otherwise a segmented picker or custom tabs.
mappings.android: Compose TabRow / ScrollableTabRow with pager or panel binding.

title: Navbar
summary: A landmark region for primary or secondary destination links across an application shell.

anatomy.name: items
anatomy.description: Collection of navigation links or menus.

anatomy.name: actions
anatomy.description: Utility actions such as search or account.

keyboard: Tab moves through interactive items
Enter activates the focused link or control
accessibility: Expose a navigation landmark with a clear name when multiple nav regions exist. Current page or section should be programmatically indicated. Compact menus must remain operable by keyboard when items collapse behind a trigger.
motion: Collapse and expand transitions may animate height; under reduced motion, toggle layout without height animation.

mappings.web: nav landmark with links; disclosure button for compact menus.
mappings.apple: SwiftUI NavigationBar / toolbar patterns appropriate to the platform idiom.
mappings.android: Compose TopAppBar or navigation bar components.

title: Sidebar
summary: A persistent or dismissible side region for hierarchical navigation.
keyboard: Tab and arrow keys move among items according to the tree or list pattern used
Enter activates the focused destination
Escape dismisses an overlay sidebar
accessibility: Provide a navigation landmark or complementary region with an accessible name. Overlay sidebars must manage focus while open and restore focus on close. Collapsed icon-only items still need names.
motion: Width or slide transitions may ease; under reduced motion, snap between expanded and collapsed layouts.

mappings.web: nav or complementary with disclosure controls; dialog-like focus handling when modal overlay.
mappings.android: Compose ModalNavigationDrawer or permanent navigation rail/drawer.

title: Dialog
summary: A modal or explicitly modality-declared overlay that interrupts the page for a focused task.

anatomy.name: backdrop
anatomy.description: Dimmed or blocking layer behind the surface.

anatomy.name: actions
anatomy.description: Action buttons such as confirm and cancel.

keyboard: Initial focus moves to the element declared by the focus contract when the dialog opens
Tab cycles inside the focus trap while open
Escape dismisses when escape dismissal is enabled
On close, focus restores to the previously focused trigger
accessibility: Modal dialogs must trap focus while open, set initial focus deliberately, allow Escape and/or backdrop dismissal when those mechanisms are part of the contract, and restore focus to the invoking control on close. Provide an accessible name from the title and optional description relationship. Do not leave inert background content reachable by keyboard or assistive technology while the modal is open.
motion: Entrance may fade and scale the surface; under reduced motion, show the settled open state without springy motion while keeping focus behavior intact.

mappings.web: Native HTML dialog or ARIA dialog/alertdialog with documented focus management.
mappings.apple: SwiftUI confirmationDialog/sheet/alert matched to modality; UIKit UIAlertController or modal presentation.
mappings.android: Compose Dialog or AlertDialog with back-handler dismissal aligned to the contract.

title: Drawer
summary: A panel that slides in from an edge to present supplementary UI.

anatomy.name: backdrop
anatomy.description: Optional blocking layer for modal drawers.

keyboard: Escape dismisses when enabled
Tab moves through interactive content while open
Focus restores to the trigger on close for modal drawers
accessibility: Declare modality. Modal drawers need focus containment and restoration; non-modal drawers must not steal focus unexpectedly. Provide an accessible name and a clear dismiss mechanism.
motion: Edge slide is expected; under reduced motion, fade or instant open/close without long travel.

mappings.web: Dialog-like pattern or complementary region depending on modality.
mappings.android: Compose ModalBottomSheet or ModalNavigationDrawer as appropriate to edge and modality.

title: Popover
summary: A non-modal anchored overlay for lightweight additional UI.
keyboard: Escape closes the popover
Tab may move into the surface when it contains focusable controls
Outside dismissal closes when enabled
accessibility: Keep non-modal behavior unless explicitly declared otherwise. Anchor and surface relationships must be programmatically exposed. Closing restores a predictable focus target, usually the anchor.
motion: Short fade or anchored scale is common; under reduced motion, show and hide without scale.

mappings.web: ARIA popover pattern or anchored dialog without modal trapping when non-modal.
mappings.android: Compose Popup or DropdownMenu anchored to a trigger.

title: Tooltip
summary: A short descriptive overlay that clarifies a control without requiring commitment.
keyboard: Focusing the anchor may show the tooltip
Escape dismisses a visible tooltip
accessibility: Tooltips must not be the only path to essential information. Prefer accessible names on icon-only controls; use tooltips as supplemental descriptions. Pointer-only tooltips are insufficient for keyboard users.
motion: Delay and fade are typical; under reduced motion, appear without fade delay beyond accessibility timing needs.

mappings.web: title only as a last resort; prefer accessible naming and aria-describedby patterns.

title: Toast
summary: A transient feedback message that confirms an outcome without blocking the entire UI.

anatomy.name: action
anatomy.description: Optional follow-up action such as Undo.

keyboard: Action and close controls are reachable by keyboard when present
Escape may dismiss when the toast is focusable or has a close control
accessibility: Announce the message through an appropriate live region or platform notification API without stealing focus unless the toast requires immediate interaction. Timeouts must give users enough time to read and act. Do not place critical errors only in ephemeral toasts.
motion: Slide or fade in/out is common; under reduced motion, fade briefly or appear statically, preserving the settled message.

mappings.web: role=status or alert depending on urgency; avoid focus traps.
mappings.apple: SwiftUI notice banners or system-style transient alerts.
mappings.android: Snackbar or Toast APIs with action affordances when required.

title: Table
summary: A tabular structure for comparing rows of related data across columns.
keyboard: Tab moves to interactive cells and controls
Arrow keys may navigate grid-like interaction when a grid pattern is declared
accessibility: Expose table or grid semantics consistently with interaction. Associate headers with cells. Sortable headers must expose sort direction. Empty and loading states need text alternatives, not only spinners.
motion: Row reordering or sort animations should be subtle; under reduced motion, update order without sliding rows.

mappings.web: Native table markup for tabular data; ARIA grid only when interaction requires it.
mappings.apple: SwiftUI Table where available, or accessible list/grid alternatives.
mappings.android: Compose table or lazy grid patterns with header semantics.

title: Card
summary: A grouped surface that presents a single related unit of content and optional actions.
keyboard: If the whole card is activatable, Enter activates it
Interactive children remain reachable by Tab
accessibility: Avoid nested conflicting interactive targets. If the card is a single control, give it one accessible name; if it contains multiple controls, do not also make the entire card a separate button without a clear pattern. Decorative media must not add redundant announcements.
motion: Hover elevation or slight translate is optional; under reduced motion, change border or background without movement.

mappings.web: article or section grouping; button/link wrapping only when the entire card is one action.
mappings.apple: SwiftUI GroupBox or custom card layout.
